Enough,Ⓒa.ⒹyaTezwa, bahula, pracura, paryApta.
Ⓑ
 2 samarTa, kzama, ucita, upayukta; oft. by alaM with inf. or dat., (tasyAlamezA kzuDitasya tfptyE R. ii. 39).
Ⓔadv.ⒹalaM, kftaM, (with instr.); ‘e(nough) of prolixity’ alamativistareRa.
Ⓑ
 2 yaTezwaM, pracuraM, paryAptaM; ‘to be e(nough) for’ kxp 1 A (with dat.); ‘rich e(nough)’ BUyasA vittavAn; with adverbs by eva or BUyasA; samyageva, BUyasA yuktaM, &c.; ‘be good e(nough) to grant my request’ mama prArTanAmanumaMtuM prasIdatu BavAn.
